WITH monthly_data AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', s.end_date) as month,
    CASE 
      WHEN p.tier = 'enterprise' THEN 'Enterprise'
      WHEN p.tier = 'pro' THEN 'Professional'
      ELSE 'SMB'
    END as segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.account_id) as churned_accounts
  FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id
  WHERE s.end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND s.end_date >= '2024-01-01'
    AND s.end_date < '2025-01-01'
    AND p.tier IN ('enterprise', 'pro', 'starter', 'growth')
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.end_date), 
    CASE 
      WHEN p.tier = 'enterprise' THEN 'Enterprise'
      WHEN p.tier = 'pro' THEN 'Professional'
      ELSE 'SMB'
    END
),

  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', generate_series) as month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FILTER (WHERE p.tier = 'enterprise') as enterprise_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FILTER (WHERE p.tier = 'pro') as pro_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FILTER (WHERE p.tier IN ('starter', 'growth')) as smb_total
  FROM generate_series('2024-01-01'::date, '2024-12-01'::date, interval '1 month') as month
  CROSS JOIN accounts a
  JOIN subscriptions s ON a.account_id = s.account_id
  JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id
  WHERE s.start_date <= month AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date > month)
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', generate_series)
)

  m.segment,
  m.churned_accounts,

    WHEN m.segment = 'Professional' THEN t.pro_total
    ELSE t.smb_total

    WHEN m.segment = 'Professional' THEN t.pro_total
    ELSE t.smb_total
  END, 0), 2) as churn_rate_pct

    AND s.end_date < '2025-01-01'

    CASE 
      WHEN p.tier = 'enterprise' THEN 'Enterprise'
      WHEN p.tier = 'pro' THEN 'Professional'
      ELSE 'SMB'
    END
),

  SELECT 
    m.month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FILTER (WHERE p.tier = 'enterprise') as enterprise_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FILTER (WHERE p.tier = 'pro') as pro_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FILTER (WHERE p.tier IN ('starter', 'growth')) as smb_total

    WHEN md.segment = 'Professional' THEN t.pro_total

-- Calculate time to first activity (activation speed)
WITH first_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    MIN(occurred_at::date) as first_active_date
  FROM events
  GROUP BY account_id
),
activation_time AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.created_at::date as signup_date,
    fa.first_active_date,
    fa.first_active_date - a.created_at::date as days_to_activate
  FROM accounts a
  LEFT JOIN first_activity fa ON a.account_id = fa.account_id
),
account_status AS (
  SELECT 
    s.account_id,
    CASE WHEN s.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'churned' ELSE 'active' END as status
  FROM subscriptions s

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN days_to_activate <= 7 THEN '0-7 days'
    WHEN days_to_activate <= 14 THEN '8-14 days'
    WHEN days_to_activate <= 30 THEN '15-30 days'
    ELSE '30+ days'
  END as activation_bucket,
